new.title: New item
new.description: It starts as a draft 1.0; publish it when its form and blueprint are ready.
new.name: Name
new.slugHint: In URLs and YAML: lower case, digits and dashes. It can't change later.
new.summaryHint: One line on the catalog's card.

import.title: Import an item
import.description: Paste or open an item exported as YAML. It comes in as a draft; nothing is published.

items.title: Items
items.description: What people can request, and the version of each they get.
items.noMatchBody: Nothing in the catalog has this name, kind, category and state.
items.emptyBody: An item is what people request: a VM, an AWX job, a workflow, or several of them together.
items.publishUnsaved: Publish: the designer has changes to save
items.publishWaits: Publish {{number}}: waits for the change running
items.withdrawBody: Nobody can request it until a version is published again. {{stays}}
items.deleteBody_one: The item and its {{count}} version are deleted. This can't be undone.
items.deleteBody_other: The item and its {{count}} versions are deleted. This can't be undone.
items.deleteConsequences: Nobody has requested it, so no deployment depends on it. It is open to {{openTo}}.
items.deleteConsequencesPublished: Nobody has requested it, so no deployment depends on it. It is open to {{openTo}}, and leaves their catalog.
items.staysMany: Versions {{versions}} stay, to roll back to.
items.staysOne: Version {{number}} stays, to roll back to.
items.builtNoneOne: No deployment was built from it.
items.builtNoneMany: No deployment was built from them.
items.builtOne_one: The {{count}} deployment built from it keeps running, with their day-2 actions.
items.builtOne_other: The {{count}} deployments built from it keep running, with their day-2 actions.
items.builtMany_one: The {{count}} deployment built from them keeps running, with their day-2 actions.
items.builtMany_other: The {{count}} deployments built from them keep running, with their day-2 actions.

categories.sheetDescription: The catalog groups its items by category, in this order.
categories.keyHint: In items' YAML: lower case, digits and dashes. It can't change later.
categories.name: Name
categories.title: Categories
categories.description: How the catalog groups its items.
categories.emptyBody: Every item is in a category: add one before the first item.
categories.removeBody: It leaves the catalog's list of categories.

secrets.sheetDescription: Stored encrypted. Its value is never shown again. A REST value source or call names it, cloud-init user data reads it as {{userData}}, an AWX step as {{awx}}.
secrets.name: Name
secrets.nameHint: Lower case letters, digits and dashes.
secrets.projectHint: A project's own secret is opened by its requests rather than the global one of the same name. Other projects never open it.
secrets.valueHint: The new value replaces the stored one at once, in every item that uses it.
secrets.shadows: Opened instead of the global one
secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.panelDescription: What REST value sources and calls sign in with, and what Windows guests, cloud-init and AWX steps are given.
secrets.emptyBody: Store the token or password a REST call, a guest or an AWX step needs; its value is never shown again.
secrets.removeBody: Its value is deleted. Storing a secret of the same name later doesn't bring it back.
secrets.removeUnused: No item or template uses it today.

needs.failing: rvav can't commit it: check the repository's settings and credentials.
needs.draft: The repository changed it: review the draft, then publish or discard it.
needs.conflict: rvav and the repository both changed it: choose which to keep.
needs.refused: The repository's file can't be imported: fix it there.
needs.deleted: The repository deleted it: rvav keeps the item.

git.sheetDescription: rvav commits each item's published version here, and reads the repository's changes back as drafts.
git.readComing: , and a read is on its way
git.committed: rvav's file will be committed over the repository's change
git.takenDraft: The repository's change is a draft
git.waiting: rvav's change will be committed at the next read of the repository.
git.refusedWhy: Why the repository's file was refused
git.ownDraft: The repository's change is draft {{number}}: review it in Versions, then publish it (rvav commits it back) or discard it (rvav's file is committed again).
git.deletedThere: The repository deleted the file: keep rvav's to add it back.
git.conflict: Keep rvav's file, committed over the repository's change; or take the repository's, as a draft (an open draft in rvav is discarded).
git.discardBody: The repository's change becomes the item's draft, in place of rvav's.
git.discardConsequences: What draft {{number}} changed is lost. The published version stays as it is.
git.fromToDraft: From rvav's file to the repository's draft
git.fromTo: From rvav's file to the repository's
git.changes: Changes from rvav's file to the repository's

sharing.projectsDescription: The projects whose catalog has it. Who may request it in each is below.
sharing.ownShares_one: {{count}} project keeps its own share, which adds to every project's.
sharing.ownShares_other: {{count}} projects keep their own share, which adds to every project's.
sharing.whoMayDescription: In each project, all the members who may request there, or only the users, groups and roles you choose. Shares add up.
sharing.notSharedBody: No project's catalog has it: nobody can request it. Share it with a project.
sharing.shareDescription: Pick a project, then who may request the item there.
sharing.projectEveryHint: Who may request it in each project, those made later included.
sharing.allMembersHint: everyone who may request in the project
sharing.chosenPeopleHint: the users, groups and roles below
sharing.oidcGroupHint: As the identity provider's token names it. Press Enter to add it.
sharing.projectRolesHint: Whoever holds one in the project, themselves or through a group.
sharing.pickOne: Who can request is shown for one project at a time: pick one.
sharing.whoCanFailed: Who can request couldn't be worked out.
sharing.alsoEverywhere: Also shared with every project: {{who}}. Shares add up.
sharing.notRequesters: {{names}} may not request in {{project}}: give them a role that may.
sharing.unseenGroup: Nobody rvav has seen is in {{group}} yet: check its name in the identity provider.

error.json: A list in [ ] or an object in { }.

variables.sheetDescription: Steps that run from then on read the value saved, in requests already running too. It isn't masked anywhere: store a password, a token or a key as a secret instead.
variables.groupHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, such as network.
variables.name: Name
variables.readAs: Steps and conditions read it as <expr/>.
variables.jsonHint: A list, such as {{example}}, or an object.
variables.title: Variables
variables.lead: Values that aren't secret and that several items share, such as a site's DNS servers. Composite steps and conditions read them as <expr/> each time they run. Store passwords and tokens as secrets instead.
variables.emptyEdit: Add a value several items share, such as a site's DNS servers, so that each reads it from one place.
variables.emptyRead: No value is shared between items yet.
variables.removeBody: Steps can no longer read it. Adding a variable of the same name later brings its use back.

wait.saving: The designer is still saving the draft.
wait.refused: The designer has changes the server refused or couldn't save: see the Form designer tab.
wait.yaml: Save or undo your changes to the YAML first.

item.refusedLines_one: A problem in its definition, shown on their lines.
item.refusedLines_other: {{count}} problems in its definition, shown on their lines.
item.refusedSteps_one: A problem in its definition, shown on their lines and steps.
item.refusedSteps_other: {{count}} problems in its definition, shown on their lines and steps.
item.draftMade: Draft {{number}} made from the published version
item.versionsLead: People request a published version: the newest, unless they pick another kept published. Requests and deployments keep the version they were made with.
item.publishSaveFirst: Publish {{number}}: save the draft's changes first
item.publishBesideSaveFirst: Publish {{number}} beside {{kept}}: save the draft's changes first
item.discardBody: Its changes are lost, in the form designer and the YAML alike.
item.discardFromGit: The draft came from the repository: rvav commits its own file there again.
item.discardNone: The item has no published version: nobody can request it.
item.frozen: Published and earlier versions never change: make a draft to edit.
item.designerPending: This shows the designer's changes, which the server hasn't saved yet; fix them here and save.

details.title: Details
details.lead: How the item shows in the catalog. Saved at once, in every version.
details.name: Name
details.tagsHint: Separated by commas. They also group the item's VMs in the AWX inventory.

item.leaveBody: Your changes to the definition are lost; the draft keeps what was last saved.

graph.notDrawn: A blueprint of kind {{kind}} isn't drawn
graph.yamlLine: The YAML doesn't parse at line {{line}}
graph.steps: Steps, in the order they run
graph.lastParsed: {{reason}}: the graph shows the definition as it last parsed.

groups.name: Name
groups.label: Label
groups.optionsHint: Separated by commas. Requesters choose one; none lets them type.
groups.helpHint: Shown under the field on the request form.
groups.inventory: A host variable in the AWX inventory
groups.changeLead: Saving makes version {{version}}. Items keep the version they name until their blueprint names this one.
groups.newLead: Inputs and constants several items share. An item's blueprint names a version of the group.
groups.keyHint: Blueprints name it, and bindings read its constants as <expr/>.
groups.inputsLead: Each joins the request form of the items naming the group, in a section of its own, as if the item declared it.
groups.constantsLead: Values the items' bindings read; requesters don't see them.
groups.title: Property groups
groups.lead: Inputs and constants several catalog items share. An item names a version of a group in its blueprint, as <blueprint/>; the group's inputs join its request form, and its bindings read the constants as <expr/>.
groups.emptyBody: Gather the inputs and values several items ask for or use, such as a cost centre or a DNS domain, once.
groups.deleteBody: Every version of the group is deleted.
groups.deleteConsequences: No published item uses it. A draft that names it is refused when next saved.

param.urlHint: On a host REST value sources may call. Read the parameters as {{expr}}.
param.bodyHint: Sent with POST. Read the parameters as {{expr}}.
param.secretHint: A stored secret's name: rvav sends it as a bearer token.
param.itemsHint: JSONPath to the list in the answer, such as $.items[*].
param.valueHint: JSONPath in each item to its value, such as $.id.
param.label: Label
param.labelHint: JSONPath in each item to what requesters see.
param.metaHint: JSONPath in each item to a detail shown under it.
param.parentHint: JSONPath in each item to its parent's value, for a tree. Empty for a flat list.
param.validHint: JSONPath to true or false in the answer. $.valid when empty.
param.messageHint: JSONPath to the refusal's message. $.message when empty.
param.errorsHint: JSONPath to messages by input, or a list of {field, message}. $.errors when empty.
param.optionsHint: A list of strings or of {value, label, meta}, from {{expr}}, environment, project and user.
param.checkHint: True, "" or {} when the form passes; false, a message, or {{shape}} when it doesn't.
param.celValueHint: One value, for a field that takes one rather than a choice.

library.noUse: No item's form names it yet.
library.changeLead: Saving makes version {{version}}, and gives each item that uses an earlier version a draft naming it, to review and publish.
library.newLead: A value source or a validation any item's form can name, giving its parameters from its inputs.
library.keyHint: Forms name the entry by its key, which doesn't change.
library.name: Name
library.purposeHint: Forms use it as one: it doesn't change.
library.searches: Searches by what the requester types (reads {{expr}})
library.messageHint: Shown when it refuses without saying why. A form's own message comes first.
library.parametersLead: What a form gives the entry, each as a CEL expression over its inputs, such as <expr/>.
library.label: Label
library.required: Required: without it, the entry doesn't run
library.testLead: Runs the entry as written, unsaved changes included, with these parameter values, as a form of this project and environment would.
library.projectHint: For project, and a REST call's secret of the project.
library.title: Form library
library.lead: Value sources and validations any item's form names by key and version, as a field's <expr/> or one of its validations. A form gives an entry's parameters as CEL over its inputs.
library.emptyBody: Write once what several forms ask a service, such as the CMDB's applications, or check before approval, such as an open cost centre.
library.deleteBody: Every version of the entry is deleted.
library.deleteConsequences: No published item uses it. A draft that names it is refused when next saved.
